title: Lost Vape UB LIte Tank
description: The Lost Vape UB Lite Tank , released with the Lost Vape Thelema Mini vape starter kit, is a versatile sub-ohm tank designed for use with Lost Vape’s improved UB Lite mesh coils, available in a range of resistances. The kit includes 1 x UB Lite L7 0.3 Ohm Mesh Coil for a rich and cloudy DTL (direct-to-lung) vape, and 1 x UB Lite L10 0.6 Ohm Mesh Coil for a RDTL (restricted direct-to-lung) / MTL (mouth-to-lung) hybrid-style vape. The kit includes two different drip tips – an MTL drip tip and a DTL drip tip – to help you get the most out of your preferred vaping style The UB Lite Tank features an innovative sliding top cap that reveals an upgraded fill port for easy, leak-free refills, and switching coils is made simple with an intuitive push-to-fit design. We recommend nic salt and high-PG e-liquids for use with the 0.6ohm UB Lite coil, and 50/50 and high-VG e-liquids for use with the 0.3ohm UB Lite coil. With its 510 connection, the Lost Vape UB Lite Tank be used with any compatible 510 Mod. Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming' simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
